Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

bayesSampleMix 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN submission.

First packaged release of the contamination-mixture research code (mixture_filter.R, mixture_filter_glm.R, mixture_filter_pois.R).

Preserved from the original code

  • Gaussian, logistic (Polya-Gamma) and Poisson (Laplace-proposal MH) samplers, models M0, Mjoint and M1, priors, initial values and default settings. Seeded fits reproduce the original functions draw for draw (verified by tests/testthat/test-equivalence.R).
  • Baseline single-sample regressions (baseline_fit()), overlap diagnostics (overlap_diagnostics(), formerly stage0()), filter-score AUC (filter_auc(), formerly auc_score()).

Changes

  • M1: the rival regression now uses its exact full conditional whenever at least one unit is allocated to it (mixture_control(m1_update = "exact")). The original rule (prior draw when <= p + 1 units) is available with m1_update = "original".
  • All retained draws are stored, including sigma^2 and the contaminating component’s parameters; realised contamination fraction added.
  • Thinning, formula interface, factor handling, missing-data policy, input validation, seed handling that restores the global RNG state.
  • overlap_diagnostics()/filter_auc() compute the AUC with the equivalent rank formula instead of an n1 x n0 matrix.

New

  • S3 methods: print(), summary() (with ESS and MCSE), coef(), vcov(), nobs(), predict(), plot(), as.matrix().
  • simulate_mixture_data(), effective_size(), filter_scores(), contamination().
